items.title: Bam Knight: Forced out of Sunday's game
items.text:
Knight headed to the locker room during Sunday's game against the Cowboys after sustaining an unspecified injury, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kendrick Bourne: Heads to locker room Sunday
items.text:
Bourne sustained an apparent right leg injury late in the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Cowboys and headed to the locker room, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Exit's Sunday's game
items.text:

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Officially has ankle injury
